notes.subject: סירתיכם
notes.rationale: Famously opaque: 'your pots' feeling the thorn-bush fire (cooking scene) vs. emendation to 'your thorns' (brambles).

notes.subject: כמו חי כמו חרון
notes.rationale: 'As living, as burning' — green and burning alike swept away (ASV/JPS) vs. KJV 'both living, and in his wrath'.

notes.subject: ⟨Yawe⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no explicit subject for ישערנו; the sweep-away agent supplied for sense.

translation: Sabu ko fo aw ka walɛnw ma se ka datokurun ye, i n'a fɔ fɔlɔ, i n'a fɔ min bɛ tasuma ɖa, ⟨Yawe⟩ bɛ o bɔ ni gɛlɛn bijɛ ye.

tokens.gloss: bɛ o bɔ ni gɛlɛn bijɛ ye
